verdict.rationale: Finix documents a Payouts Dashboard and >10 automated report types (transactions, disputes, fees) plus seller-payout management tools, which could support reconciliation and reporting, but there's no explicit evidence of a seller-facing self-serve statement/export portal that sellers or their bookkeepers can access directly without going through the platform's ops team. Missing for 10: seller-facing self-serve statement/export UI, explicit reconciliation report for bookkeeper close-out, and any confirmation that sellers (not just the platform) can pull these reports themselves.
